overall: Informal resolution finding no violation: the notice that the board would consider a special permit to park heavy commercial vehicles was specific enough, and the follow-on one-vehicle motion was within the agenda item.

allegations.summary: The complaint alleged the posted agenda did not describe the special permit matter with sufficient specificity.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the agenda item was sufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: The complaint alleged the board's discussion of a motion to permit one heavy vehicle, rather than the two posted, was improper because the notice did not cover a one-vehicle permit.
allegations.key_passage: The discussion which followed naturally flowed from the Board's consideration of the agenda item and its members' reactions to the application.
